decision.reason: Section 6 requires both arms coefficient of variation <=2%. Upstream Vulkan max per-case CV is 9.24%/4.73% at p512/p1024, so it cannot define those closure targets despite deterministic outputs.
decision.unblock: Stabilize the eligible Vulkan lane and rerun it first. Only after every shape is <=2% CV should current production be rerun immediately in the same thermal window for paired confidence intervals.
